pr_summary: Implement runtime-configurable certificate verification skipping for IBM Secure Execution verifier via SE_SKIP_CERTS_VERIFICATION environment variable. The fix removes the debug-only restriction, allowing the environment variable to work in both debug and release builds.
special_system_dependencies: s390x architecture for IBM SE testing
patch_file_cues: deps/verifier/src/se/ibmse.rs - removes #[cfg(debug_assertions)] conditional, makes SE_SKIP_CERTS_VERIFICATION work in release builds
test_file_cues: deps/verifier/src/snp/mod.rs - example of TEE verifier tests with rstest
platform_constraint_evidence: IBM SE verifier targets s390x Linux architecture but code compiles on x86_64
notes: The repository is the confidential-containers/trustee project at commit 79722e7. The fix modifies the IBM SE verifier to allow runtime certificate verification skipping via SE_SKIP_CERTS_VERIFICATION environment variable in both debug and release builds. The previous implementation only allowed this in debug builds via #[cfg(debug_assertions)]. The project uses Rust with Cargo as the build system. Tests use rstest framework. The IBM SE verifier is specifically for s390x (IBM Z) architecture but the code can be compiled on x86_64 for development. No test.patch is provided, so hidden tests will need to be synthesized. Key environment variables: SE_SKIP_CERTS_VERIFICATION, SE_CERTIFICATES_ROOT, SE_CERTIFICATE_REVOCATION_LISTS_ROOT, SE_HOST_KEY_DOCUMENTS_ROOT, SE_IMAGE_HEADER_FILE, SE_MEASUREMENT_ENCR_KEY_PRIVATE, SE_MEASUREMENT_ENCR_KEY_PUBLIC.
